assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only azur-lane:st-louis@mobile-game#azur-lane-st-louis-character-monograph, the canonical frozen V1 constrained monograph AZUR_LANE_ST_LOUIS_CHARACTER_MONOGRAPH.md at basis_commit, read in full as reviewed repository analysis of the pinned CN-origin Azur Lane client corpus (build AZL-2026-08-22-4cca5c24-cc8e9fdf) as the monograph summarizes it: 18 linked narrative records, no dedicated character-memory group, 29 base-skin and 48 non-base-skin dialogue records, 8 affinity records, 1 oath record, 7 combat records, 2 relationship-specific records, 5 Juustagram appearances and JP/EN/TW/KR regional witnesses, with 71 mapped JP spoken utterances. The R5 adversarial audit, R6 relationship-state synthesis, R7 multilingual speech profile, JP audio reconciliation audit, JP voice performance profile, impact ledger and extracted corpus files are not curated on this subject and were not used. The project's readiness grade C, score 57.3 and simulator-status labels are inputs, not conclusions. The evaluator performed no primary-source inspection and no audio audition.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: The live-service game has no single story chronology. The monograph orders St. Louis's Commander relationship functionally (C0 familiar baseline, C1 private access, C2 direct intimacy, oath) and says that order is not a guaranteed canon sequence across skin releases; peer scenes are cited by scene key and record ID without dates. The yihailiusheng event scenes, including the catastrophic yihailiusheng17, are treated by the monograph as alternate-context, lower-tier support. Claims cover the corpus pinned at the build above; content released after that build is outside the boundary.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, including the owner calibration rulings; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: A social-operator model with ten decision rules (S1-S10): stagnation invites intervention, mild embarrassment is treated as survivable, care changes the environment, luck modifies strategy without removing agency, and serious substantive risk reduces joking. It names her failure mode, paternalistic confidence, from the Boise wager she meant to end the same way whoever won (boyixi6 0003-0015) and from continuing after Honolulu's protest (huonululu2). Not B: the monograph cannot say which priority decides once a recipient clearly separates distress from face-saving embarrassment and repeats a hard stop (OPEN-3); that sits inside the core steering mechanism and is insufficiency, not productive uncertainty. The danger branch rests on the yihailiusheng event scenes the monograph itself ranks as alternate-context, lower-tier support, and anger, grief and ideology are open. Not D: the rules are explicit, located and adversarially revised (R5 Tests A-G), and they predict her overreach.

The only state progression is the functional Commander ladder (C0-C2, oath) drawn from affinity, oath and skin records, and the monograph declines to treat it as canon chronology. No peer relationship or self-concept is shown changing over time, and there is no memory sequence.

The JP register is specified: 指揮官くん as the dominant Commander address, わ, わよ, かしら, ね, あら, うふふ and てちょうだい, rhetorical invitation questions with note symbols, and a warning against Takao-like 指揮官殿 formality. The CN markers are 呵呵, 嘻嘻, 哎呀, segmented 指·挥·官 emphasis and Lucky Lou code-switching, and the provocation-then-retreat grammar is described. The fixed-procedure acoustic findings on 71 JP utterances say intimacy is often lower and controlled, combat projection higher and more compact. Not A: EN, TW and KR registers are not profiled, perceptual timbre is open, and the monograph quotes few full lines.

Leisure and ordinary conduct are located across skins and ensemble scenes: she prefers lively occasions, drinks socially, drives, takes an interest in fashion and fabrics, offers to help at a gathering, accepts the host's 'guests should rest' and greets old friends. The monograph gives a dinner-guest model and marks long domestic routine OPEN. Not B: much of this comes from skin framing and one ensemble event, with no account of a day. Not D: the dinner and party behavior is conditioned and bounded, for example no culinary expertise.

Behavior is conditioned by relationship and explained: with Helena, welfare at stake gives safety over winning (hailunna1, hailunna7, 102130:couple_encourage:0); with Honolulu, care coexists with admitted amusement and mild resistance is managed rather than obeyed (huonululu2); with Boise, individualized gifts sit beside engineered exposure (boyixi3, boyixi6); with the Commander, low formality from the start and intimacy that grows by permission and exclusivity rather than by a shift in temperament. Not A: each peer rule rests on one to three scenes, strangers are handled only by the generic dinner model, and non-Commander romance is OPEN.

There is no dedicated memory sequence and no interior narration is cited. Every interior claim is labeled inferred (INFERRED_DISPOSITION, a 'plausible recurring appraisal' explicitly not a quotation), apart from the apology she makes in alternate injury material. Supports only bounded canon questions about stated attitudes such as the luck lines.

Located conflict-adjacent material: she enforces the agreed bet on Boise, continues past Honolulu's 'not your business', and uses luck rhetoric in combat lines (battle, hp_warning, lose, win_mvp). Combat performance is acoustically more compact. The monograph marks anger and conflict OPEN, so there is no operational model of open disagreement or hostility.

Norms are listed with evidence: discretion about intimacy in public (touch2), keeping bet commitments, safety over winning for Helena, leisure as legitimate, and no evidence of lying about serious facts for advantage. The monograph marks ideology OPEN and gives no dilemma in which these norms conflict.

One of the best-supported domains: typed humor forms (innuendo, feigned innocence, 'classified information' games, provocation with a joke retreat), the rule that the exit ramp may be rhetorical while the social objective stays (S5), embarrassment used as conversational fuel, and humor that drops when risk is substantive (S6, R5 Test G). Not A: the play is heavily Commander-facing and skin-sourced, and the peer sample is the three named friends.

The monograph states its corpus composition and biases: COMMANDER_HEAVY at about 79.2 percent, SKIN_HEAVY at about 62.3 percent, 171 of 980 regional candidates unaligned, no memory group, no Fleet Chat, 18 narrative records. Peer scenes are weighted to correct the bias. Not B: the base is thin for anything outside low-stakes social and Commander contexts, and the evaluator could not recheck the extraction.

Affirmative counterevidence shapes the model: luck lines that reject fatalism and luck-only victory (102130:profile:0, upgrade:0, win_mvp:0); the admitted concern and recruited expert in the META discussion (yihailiusheng12, alternate-context) against a carefree reading; Boise and Honolulu against perfect empathy and against a consent model in which any protest ends her steering (R5 Tests B and C); and the 71-utterance measurement against 'seductive but easily flustered' delivery (Test F). Not A: several anti-caricature rules, such as no culinary skill or formal leadership, are absences rather than contradictions.

Claims are located by record ID and scene key, but not in time; the Commander states are functional and the alternate-context event material is kept separate. Use of a claim depends on choosing the relationship state, not a chronological point.

conditions: Output is illustrative and labeled noncanonical, never presented as a quotation.
Output locale is CN or JP, using the documented markers; EN, TW and KR stylistic claims are not made.
The recipient is the Commander at a named functional state or a named peer (Helena, Honolulu, Boise), chosen before wording.
No perceptual-timbre or performance claim beyond the stated acoustic tendencies.
scenario_readiness.note: The register markers and interactional grammar constrain wording well for CN and JP in low-stakes social contexts.

conditions: Low-stakes social novelty covered by section 26: dinner with friendly strangers, meeting a shy young woman, a technical controversy, or mild failure in a game.
Flirtation is not transferred to anyone but the Commander; a stranger gets peer-level initiative and teasing only if embarrassed but not distressed.
Abstain where the scenario turns on a clarified hard stop, open anger, grief, a moral dilemma or non-Commander romance.
Serious danger to Helena is a lower-confidence condition because its strongest support is alternate-context.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: No story chronology; the pinned build AZL-2026-08-22-4cca5c24-cc8e9fdf, with the Commander at a named functional state if present.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: The Commander at a named state, Helena, Honolulu or Boise as sampled, or a friendly stranger treated as a peer without invented history.
setting_constraints: Port, party, dinner, leisure or routine-duty settings.
No high-stakes interpersonal rejection, sustained grief or command-leadership setting.
Alternate yihailiusheng contexts only as lower-tier support.

scenario_readiness.note: Section 26 predictions are bounded and flagged; the core open question limits transfer to low-stakes settings.

conditions: Party, dinner, drink, drive, shopping or fashion interaction with the Commander or a named peer.
She is a socially engaged guest, not an established cook.
Public-private discretion about intimacy is kept (touch2).
scenario_readiness.note: The best-supported surface, with a Commander-heavy and skin-heavy composition warning.
The monograph records ideology as OPEN and gives listed norms without any case where they conflict; it supports canon questions about those norms, not deliberation.

conditions: The partner is the Commander at a named functional state (C0, C1, C2 or oath).
Intimacy grows by permission, exclusivity and reciprocal access, without a shy transformation.
No non-Commander romance and no claim that the states form a canon sequence.
scenario_readiness.note: Commander romance is directly and repeatedly evidenced, with the composition warning.

conditions: Secretary duty, routine reports, sortie lines or informal coordination of peers.
Technical uncertainty is met by admitted concern and recruited expertise.
No formal command leadership or military doctrine.
scenario_readiness.note: Professional routine and informal coordination are located; formal leadership is unsupported.

known_limits.statement: About 79.2 percent of the corpus is Commander-facing and about 62.3 percent skin-sourced; the monograph forbids letting Commander flirtation define her personality and weights the peer scenes to correct for it.
St. Louis has no dedicated character-memory group and no Fleet Chat, and the corpus has 18 linked narrative records; interior claims are inferences from conduct.
Mild or face-saving protest does not reliably end her social steering (Boise, Honolulu, R5 Test C); a consent model in which any protest ends it is rejected.
The strongest high-stakes protection and guilt material (yihailiusheng17 and the injury apology) is alternate-context and carried at lower confidence.
No source test shows how she responds when someone clearly separates genuine distress from face-saving embarrassment and repeats a hard stop (OPEN-3). Missing support is not evidence of absence.
Sustained grief, anger and conflict, deep ideology, formal leadership, long domestic routine, cooking competence and non-Commander romance are OPEN in the monograph.
EN, TW and KR registers have structural presence but no stylistic profile; the monograph says they should not be guessed from CN or JP.

The R5-R7 specialist files, the audio reconciliation and voice performance profiles, the impact ledger and the extracted corpus are not curated on this subject, so the record IDs, acoustic figures and adversarial outcomes were not rechecked here.
